items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I hated the way Milt Hinton played

ctx.x: What do you think of some of the young players coming up on the instrument?

Oh I hate ‘em. The bass players? Yeah. Well I hated the way Milt Hinton played but if you were a bass player trying to make a living in this business you’d hate him too. Oh I think it’s fabulous. It’s a flip answer, but I mean there seems to be more going on now

than ever, but with the exception of some of these jazz parties and stuff it’s kind of like sports. It’s almost like it’s a kid’s game. I see myself looking at I don’t know what down the road. I don’t see — and these jazz parties, how long are they going to go on?
